Daniel and Toni return home from their honeymoon to their new life, including their blended family and Daniel's mother, all under one roof.
The family becomes ill which leaves Daniel to take care of DJ's class assignment to care for an automated doll; Lorraine substitutes for Toni's class and almost costs Toni her job.
Daniel and Michael are forced to attend communication therapy; the kids fight for equal rights of their household chores.
Daniel's ex-wife, Michelle, comes to visit, and the family anxiously awaits her arrival; Michael's girlfriend has Daniel worried.
Daniel's brother, Lionel, visits and sibling rivalry takes over; Toni tries to improve the school's dress code.
Toni wants to join a new church which frustrates Lorraine and a rift runs through the family; DJ has tryouts at school but is a little over-enthusiastic.
